snippet.title: HOSHIOMIO -Stella Attacks- Stage 2 Gameplay [Indie Game in Development](ホシオミオ -STELLA ATTACKS-プレイ動画)
snippet.description:
HOSHIOMIO - Stella Attacks -
Stage 2: The Early Difficulty Spike.
A fierce battle for survival. With stars and enemies raining down in rapid succession, you’ll be working almost non-stop to stay alive.

ホシオミオ - STELLA ATTACKS - 英語版
ステージ２、序盤の難所。激しい攻防戦。
次々に星やエネミーが降ってくるため、ほぼ絶え間なく働き続けます。
